objective: make E075 shared command replay immutable, generation updates transactional, and native non-success retry semantics replay-safe

service_snapshot.source: peer-writable shared mapping after acquire fence
service_snapshot.destination: one private bounded heap snapshot per referenced stream

generation_transaction.commit: one memcpy after every referenced stream validates and every generation update succeeds
generation_transaction.reclamation: on ENOSPC, one bounded scan removes only typed command-buffer IDs that no longer resolve in the connection context, then retries once

tests.snapshot_mutation: source byte is mutated after snapshot and snapshot remains unchanged
tests.atomic_generation_failure: first valid update plus later ENOSPC leaves the real two-entry table byte-identical
tests.reclamation_lifecycle: one dead typed command-buffer entry is reclaimed while one live entry is preserved
tests.native_non_success_retry: clean opcode 105 returns VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY, releases the slot, and retry is asserted as opcode 85

E077: replace per-submit mapped-memory flush socket fan-out with a shared dirty-memory transport
reduce the global client recording mutex bottleneck
deferred.disconnect_cleanup: bounded later lifecycle work; service-side per-connection unmap and context destruction remain intact
